title: Board-Game Win Rate by Player Count
dataSources: Game sessions (`game:session`), ranked matches (`ranked:match`), co-op invites (`coop:session`), speedrun attempts (`speedrun:attempt`), server events (`server:event`), board-game plays (`boardgame:play`), raid attempts (`raid:attempt`), and daily quest logs (`quest:completion`).
app: Gaming telemetry from platform session APIs, ranked-match exports, co-op schedulers, speedrun splits, server logs, raid trackers, and board-game play records streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=boardgame:play
| stats sum(eval(if(result="win",1,0))) as wins count as plays by game player_count
| eval win_pct=round(100*wins/plays,1)
| sort game player_count
description: Calculates how often you win each board game at different table sizes.
value: Many games feel different at different player counts, and this shows whether the outcomes really change for you.
implementation: Import board-game play records with player count and result from BoardGameGeek or your own tracker.
visualization: Heat map of win percentage by game and player count.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which games you tend to do better or worse at when more people are playing.
